label: orchestration-summary.json reports only aggregate failure classes; it has no per-lineage label/status/reason/rerun_command array, so an operator must open the status log to learn which lineage failed and what to type.

The dashboard frontier section shows band spend and a node count but no per-node visits or status, so three single-node passes and three passes on one node look identical even though the registry already holds the visit records.
Every observability-events.jsonl row carries subject.run_id null, so the event stream cannot be joined to a run or a lineage without parsing free text.

The quota failure names the cause but not the action; the single-executor workflow already has the actionable line 'Switch executor or wait, then resume this run', and the fan-out path does not carry it or a lineage-specific resume step.

A 3-node CLI lineage gets the flat 10-iteration floor, which funds only 5 depth-1 visits; this lineage's own dashboard shows 3 of 5 spent after three first passes, leaving no room for the verification pass each node needs.

direction: Claiming the dashboard hides band spend
reason: The dashboard prints all three band allotments and their spend; the missing dimension is per-node detail.
